adjudication.rationale: In the newly added webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), the decrypted payload is parsed with `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` without any try/catch or zod validation of the decrypted structure. If `reqBody.keys` is not valid encrypted JSON (or decrypts to non-JSON), `JSON.parse` will throw and Next.js will return a 500. The note about `symmetricDecrypt(... || "")` causing misconfiguration-related 500s is less directly supported because the handler gates on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (which depends on `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`), but the unhandled `JSON.parse` exception is verifiable from the diff.
